name: m1k3-app-store
description: M1K3 — App Store Connect screenshot system (iPhone 6.9", iPad 13", Mac). Real captures in plates/, brand frames rendered by Playwright.

scripts.contact: ./contact.py out/ios/en-US out/contact-ios.png && ./contact.py out/ipad/en-US out/contact-ipad.png && ./contact.py out/mac/en-US out/contact-mac.png
scripts.verify: ./verify.py out/ios/en-US --target ios --plates plates/ios && ./verify.py out/ipad/en-US --target ipad --plates plates/ipad && ./verify.py out/mac/en-US --target mac --plates plates/mac
scripts.ios: node render.js ios en-US && ./contact.py out/ios/en-US out/contact-ios.png && ./verify.py out/ios/en-US --target ios --plates plates/ios
scripts.ipad: node render.js ipad en-US && ./contact.py out/ipad/en-US out/contact-ipad.png && ./verify.py out/ipad/en-US --target ipad --plates plates/ipad
scripts.mac: node render.js mac en-US && ./contact.py out/mac/en-US out/contact-mac.png && ./verify.py out/mac/en-US --target mac --plates plates/mac
